Introduction

Hyuk Kwon also known as Dean is a South Korean R&B singer-songwriter, rapper, and record producer under You.will.knovv. He is a member of FANXY Child an R&B and hip-hop group, he is considered the "R&B Prince of Asia".

After his debut single [I’m Not Sorry] in 2015, DEAN is an alternative R&B artist who has collaborated with multiple artists such as Daniel Caesar, Anderson Paak., Syd, and Eric Bellinger, allowing him to grow as an internationally acclaimed artist. His influence reaches a wide range of scenes, from music to fashion to art in general. As the leader of the alternative collective You.will.knovv, he relentlessly continues to create a new wave of trend. After a long hiatus since 2019 from social media and music he greeted long and awaiting fans and new fans in 2023 with new music.
